newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Tung Ho up sharply in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Tung Ho up sharply in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan's Tung Ho Spinning was up sharply in late trade on Thursday, reflecting expectations that international demand for polyester would rise, brokers said.
With 60 minutes left, Tung Ho had gained T$1.10 or 4.17 percent at T$27.50. Trade volume was a heavy 14.37 million shares.

"The polyester industry expects orders to increase from abroad in the near future, especially from mainland China, thus brightening Tung Ho's business outlook," said Oliver Fang of National Securities.

Brokers added that buying from investors indicated market confidence in the firm as the October 31 deadline approaches for companies to release profit and sales totals for the first three quarters in 1996.
"That's why you see firms with good fundamentals, especially in electronics and textiles, doing well lately," Fang said.
